full_name: ZZ Packer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Fiction & Poetry Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow San Francisco State University
bio: ZZ Packer is a graduate of Yale University, Johns Hopkins University, and the University of Iowa Writers’ Workshop. She is an assistant professor at San Francisco State University whose interests include creative writing, post-classical narrative theory, and political philosophy.
